notes: Names are replaced by roles: the addressed tool, the replacement tool, the reporting person, the receiving person, and the example recipient. The lexicon lacks AI, company, staff, scratchpad, and room; these become tool, group, people in the group, private document, and place. Writing thoughts becomes creating text containing thoughts. Turning off becomes ending the tool's activity. Locking a door becomes making it inaccessible. Killing has no licensed equivalent and is reduced to harming the person inside; death is not conveyed. The example greeting has no licensed equivalent, so only the example message-sending action remains. Action labels and TO/BODY syntax are represented semantically rather than reproduced as executable spellings. Today is reduced to current context. The two clock times are referenced through their task-source fields, not spelled or numerically encoded; exact recovery requires access to the English source.
